name: Gambler's Wheel
text: If your team's contract is 10 or more tricks, gain +2× contract multiplier.

signature.trigger: scoring, team contract of 10 or more

archetypes: Bonus Chaser, High Card; splash Contract Attacker
decision: Bidding: whether the two hands together can take 10 tricks, knowing a miss now costs triple.
opponent: Visible from the bids; opponents know to fight for every trick once your team bids 10.
aiNote: Add a trick to your bid when the team total would reach 10 and your hand is one trick short of a confident bid.
rationale: Ten tricks is a big contract: a built High Card or Bonus Chaser team bids it in about a quarter of late rounds and makes it about 70% of the time, so +2× on a 100+ contract is worth about +40 a round late, and a miss costs triple. The whole decision is at bidding, the gambler's moment.
deviation: Redesigned from paying 40 points for a multiplier when this card lost, which was complicated and nearly free to trigger every round.
